records.jp: いいところに来たわね
records.en_original: Perfect timing.
records.en_auxiliary: Perfect timing.
records.en: Perfect timing.

records.jp: 何か用だった？
records.en_original: Do you need something?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you need something?
records.en: Do you need something?

records.jp: これから生徒会室に行かなきゃだから、<CR>呼びに行こうと思ってたのよ
records.en_original: We need to go to the student council room, so I was just about to call you.
records.en_auxiliary: We need to go to the student council room, so I was just about to call you.
records.en: We need to go to the student council room, so I was just about to call you.

records.jp: 生徒会室？
records.en_original: The student council room?
records.en_auxiliary: The student council room?
records.en: The student council room?

records.jp: 文化祭の詳細が決まったから届け出に行くのよ。<CR>取り仕切りは生徒会がしてるから
records.en_original: We've settled the details for the school festival, so we need to submit a report. The student council handles that.
records.en_auxiliary: We've settled the details for the culture festival, so we need to submit a report. The student council handles that.
records.en: We've settled the details for the school festival, so we need to submit a report. The student council handles that.

records.jp: あなたも知っておく必要があるでしょ？
records.en_original: It's probably important for you to know how.
records.en_auxiliary: It's probably important for you to know how.
records.en: It's probably important for you to know how.

records.jp: そうだったんだ。わかったよ
records.en_original: Oh, I see. I got it.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I see. I got it.
records.en: Oh, I see. I got it.

records.jp: じゃあ、行くわよ
records.en_original: Then let's go.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, let's go.
records.en: Then let's go.

records.jp: 失礼します
records.en_original: Excuse us.
records.en_auxiliary: Excuse us.
records.en: Excuse us.

records.jp: あら、あなたは……
records.en_original: Ah, you're...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, you're...
records.en: Ah, you're...

records.jp: たしか１年の蜷川麻央さんね。女優をしている。<CR>もしかして、文化祭のことかしら？
records.en_original: First year, Mao Ninagawa. You also work as an actress. Is this about the school festival?
records.en_auxiliary: First year, Mao Ninagawa. You also work as an actress. Is this about the culture festival?
records.en: First year, Ninagawa Mao-san. You also work as an actress. Is this about the school festival?

records.jp: はい。１年生合同の出し物の詳細がまとまりましたので、<CR>その申請に来ました
records.en_original: It is. We've finalized the details for the first year collaboration, so we're here to submit the application.
records.en_auxiliary: It is. We've finalized the details for the first year collaboration, so we're here to submit the application.
records.en: It is. We've finalized the details for the first year collaboration, so we're here to submit the application.

records.jp: そうなの。じゃあ一度見せてくれる？
records.en_original: I see. Can we take a look?
records.en_auxiliary: I see. Can we take a look?
records.en: I see. Can we take a look?

records.jp: はい
records.en_original: By all means.
records.en_auxiliary: By all means.
records.en: By all means.

records.jp: （麻央の猫かぶった姿、久しぶりに見たなー……）
records.en_original: (I haven't seen Mao put on an act in a while...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I haven't seen Mao put on an act in a while.)
records.en: (I haven't seen Mao put on an act in a while...)

records.jp: ごめんね。この書類、訂正してきてくれる？
records.en_original: I'm sorry. Could you go correct and resubmit these papers?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry. Could you go correct and resubmit these papers?
records.en: I'm sorry. Could you go correct and resubmit these papers?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: どこかミスがありましたか？
records.en_original: Is there some sort of mistake?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there some sort of mistake?
records.en: Is there some sort of mistake?

records.jp: さすがに予算がかかり過ぎよ。<CR>もっとコストカットしてきて
records.en_original: The estimated budget is too high. You need to cut costs.
records.en_auxiliary: The estimated budget is too high. You need to cut costs.
records.en: The estimated budget is too high. You need to cut costs.

records.jp: そんな！　ちゃんと支給された予算内に収めてるじゃないですか
records.en_original: It can't be! We budgeted everything out in accordance with the budget we were told we'd have...
records.en_auxiliary: It can't be! We budgeted everything out in accordance with the budget we were told we'd have.
records.en: It can't be! We budgeted everything out in accordance with the budget we were told we'd have...

records.jp: 年々文化祭の予算も減ってきててね……。<CR>どの学年も大変な中、可能な限り削ってくれてるのよ
records.en_original: The budget for the school festival has been dropping every year... Every class has had to cut costs.
records.en_auxiliary: The budget for the culture festival has been dropping every year. Every class has had to cut costs.
records.en: The budget for the school festival has been dropping every year... Every class has had to cut costs.

records.jp: それなのに、１年生が気にせず使うと心象が悪いでしょ？
records.en_original: It would leave a bad impression were the first year class to disregard that. Don't you agree?
records.en_auxiliary: It would leave a bad impression were the first year class to disregard that. Don't you agree?
records.en: It would leave a bad impression were the first year class to disregard that. Don't you agree?

records.jp: それは……
これはあなたたちのためでもあるのよ？<CR>だから悪いんだけど、もう一度考えて来て
records.en_original: We're doing this for your own good. We're really sorry, but please rethink your expenses and come back.
records.en_auxiliary: We're doing this for your own good. We're really sorry, but please rethink your expenses and come back.
records.en: We're doing this for your own good. We're really sorry, but please rethink your expenses and come back.

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en_auxiliary: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: 麻央。一度戻って考えてみよう
records.en_original: Mao. Let's go for now and think things over.
records.en_auxiliary: Mao. Let's go for now and think things over.
records.en: Mao. Let's go for now and think things over.

records.jp: そうね……
records.en_original: Right...
records.en_auxiliary: Right.
records.en: Right...

records.jp: ……あり得ない
records.en_original: ...I can't believe them.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe them.
records.en: ...I can't believe them.

records.jp: ま、麻央。落ち着いて
records.en_original: M-Mao, calm down.
records.en_auxiliary: M-Mao, calm down.
records.en: M-Mao, calm down.

records.jp: こっちは予算守ってるのよ？<CR>それがあんな理由で却下されるなんて
records.en_original: We followed the budget THEY gave us, and they rejected us for it!
records.en_auxiliary: We followed the budget THEY gave us, and they still rejected it!
records.en: We followed the budget THEY gave us, and they rejected us for it!

records.jp: 何か怪しいよね。<CR>こっちはちゃんとルール守ってるんだから
records.en_original: Something seems suspicious. We did follow the rules.
records.en_auxiliary: Something seems suspicious. We did follow the rules.
records.en: Something seems suspicious. We did follow the rules.

records.jp: 珍しいわね。私も同意見よ。<CR>たぶん、生徒会は何かを隠してる
records.en_original: It really does seem strange, I agree. The student council must be hiding something.
records.en_auxiliary: It really does seem strange. I agree. The student council must be hiding something.
records.en: It really does seem strange, I agree. The student council must be hiding something.

records.jp: うーん。どうしようか？
records.en_original: Hmm. What should we do?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. What should we do?
records.en: Hmm. What should we do?

records.jp: どの部分が削れるかな……？
records.en_original: What do you think we should cut...?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think we should cut?
records.en: What do you think we should cut...?

records.jp: はぁ？　何を言ってるの？
records.en_original: Huh? Are you serious?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Are you serious?
records.en: Huh? Are you serious?

records.jp: 何って……少しでも予算を削らないと……
records.en_original: What do you mean...? They said we need to cut the budget...
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean? They said we need to winnow down the budget.
records.en: What do you mean...? They said we need to cut the budget...

records.jp: するわけないでしょ。私達はルールを守っているんだもの
records.en_original: That's not happening. We followed the rules to a T.
records.en_auxiliary: That's not happening. We followed the rules to a T.
records.en: That's not happening. We followed the rules to a T.

records.jp: じゃあどうするの？
records.en_original: Then what should we do?
records.en_auxiliary: Then, what should we do?
records.en: Then what should we do?

records.jp: 調べましょう
records.en_original: Let's investigate.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's investigate.
records.en: Let's investigate.

records.jp: ええ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: どう考えても理屈が合わないわ。<CR>試しに他の学年の実行委員にも聞いてみましょう
records.en_original: I can't think of any good reason to lie to us about this. We should try asking the committees for other classes.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't think of any good reason to lie to us about this. We should try asking the committees for other classes.
records.en: I can't think of any good reason to lie to us about this. We should try asking the committees for other classes.

records.jp: わかった。じゃあ行く？
records.en_original: Alright, should we start now?
records.en_auxiliary: All right, should we start now?
records.en: Alright, should we start now?

records.jp: 何言ってるの？　行くのはあなた一人よ
records.en_original: What do you mean, "we"? You're going by yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean, "we"? You're going by yourself.
records.en: What do you mean, "we"? You're going by yourself.

records.jp: ええ！？
records.en_original: What!?
records.en_auxiliary: What?!
records.en: What!?

records.jp: 私が行ったら警戒されるでしょ？<CR>その間、私は別のことを調べる必要があるし……
records.en_original: Seeing me would only put them on guard. Besides, I have other things to investigate in the meantime...
records.en_auxiliary: Seeing me would only put them on guard. Besides, I have other things to investigate in the meantime.
records.en: Seeing me would only put them on guard. Besides, I have other things to investigate in the meantime...

records.jp: 別のことって？
records.en_original: What other things?
records.en_auxiliary: What other things?
records.en: What other things?

records.jp: いいから早く行きなさい。<CR>確認が済んだら伝えるから
records.en_original: Don't worry about that, just go. I'll let you know after I'm done checking.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about that. Just go. I'll let you know what I find out after, too.
records.en: Don't worry about that, just go. I'll let you know after I'm done checking.

records.jp: ひとまず２、３年の実行委員の顔を送っておいたから、<CR>その人に接触しなさい
records.en_original: I sent you photos of the committee members for the second and third year classes, go contact them.
records.en_auxiliary: I sent you photos of the committee members for the second and third year classes. Go contact them.
records.en: I sent you photos of the committee members for the second and third year classes, go contact them.

records.jp: そうね……怪しまれないように、<CR>どんな風に予算を削ればいいか聞いてきて
records.en_original: Also... Ask them about ways to shave the budget, and keep from arousing too much suspicion.
records.en_auxiliary: Also, ask them about ways to shave the budget, and keep from arousing too much suspicion.
records.en: Also... Ask them about ways to shave the budget, and keep from arousing too much suspicion.

records.jp: わ、わかった
records.en_original: R-Right.
records.en_auxiliary: R-right.
records.en: R-Right.

records.jp: （すごい手際いいなー。けど、それを聞いて何になるんだろう？）
records.en_original: (She's really good at this. But what's the point in asking about something like that?)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's really good at this. But what's the point in asking about something like that?)
records.en: (She's really good at this. But what's the point in asking about something like that?)

records.jp: うーん――
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...
